messages:
mira: Quick sync — proposal for header-driven model selection at the gateway.

mira: If request has header `x-rw-model` treat as model alias or exact ref. Rules:
- exact ref (e.g. `mpt-7b@v3`) => serve that version if available
- alias (e.g. `search-embed`) => resolve to route mapping
- absent header => use route.default_model

jason: +1. Add fallback chain: exact pinned -> alias-resolved -> compatibility-group match -> route default -> hard fail.

sophie: UX: if we auto-fallback we MUST emit `x-rw-served-model` in response and surface in Console logs & rollout timeline.

allen: Quotas: important — if alias resolves to dedicated pool and we fallback to hosted, we should NOT charge against dedicated reserved capacity. Need tagging in telemetry.

mira: Example header values:
```
x-rw-model: "search-embed"           # alias
x-rw-model: "embed-model@sha256:ab12" # exact pinned ref
x-rw-model: "capable:text-qa"        # capability selector
```

jason: Compat checks: every model has capability tags + tokenizer hash. Reject fallback if tokenizer mismatch for in-flight conversations. Pseudocode:
```
if tokenizer(hash) != convo.tokenizer_hash: reject 409
elif not model.capabilities.superset(request.features): try next
```

sophie: For rollouts: warn when pinning across major tokenizer or major version. Offer "pin for N requests" window in Console.

allen: Also consider header override precedence: route-level pinning > header exact ref > header alias > default. But header should allow ops emergency override when route is broad.

mira: Agreed. We should add a metric for "header_override_count" and add a diagnostic link in the Console to view origin chain for each request.

deploy-bot: policy-update: model-routing v2 deployed to staging at 1781234575 :package:

sophie: Looks good. I'll sketch Console bubble for "served model" + notify when fallback used.

jason: I'll open a small RFC for the compatibility matrix and quota tagging.

mira: Thanks everyone. Action items: jason RFC, sophie Console mock, allen quota telemetry + tagging. Ping if blocked :pray:

allen: :thumbsup:

sophie: :+1:

jason: on it.
